data.description:
Produce the zip the recruiter receives and prove it works from a fresh directory using only the README. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §12; Instructions.pdf ("send us a zip of your project, code plus a short README").

Why: the last mile. The zip must run on a machine that has only Docker, and the README must be sufficient on its own.

Scope:
- `make dist`: builds dist/brillio-listings-YYYYMMDD.zip from a clean tree excluding .git, node_modules, *.db, .lattice, dist, the two handout PDFs, and OS cruft. Prints the size and the file list summary.
- scripts/verify-dist.sh: extracts the zip into a fresh temporary directory, runs `docker compose up -d`, waits for health, runs the smoke checks from BC-13, runs `make check` (natively if Go and Node are present, otherwise inside the containers), tears down, and cleans up. Fails on any emoji codepoint in the extracted tree.
- Fix whatever the fresh-directory run surfaces (a missing file in the zip, a README step that assumes local state, a path that only worked in the original checkout).

Acceptance:
- `make dist` then `scripts/verify-dist.sh dist/<zip>` passes end to end.
- The README in the zip is sufficient: the verifier follows only its commands.
- Zip contains no .lattice, .git, node_modules, databases or PDFs.

Validation: the verify-dist output is the evidence; attach with --role validation along with the zip size.
data.title: Release packaging: make dist zip and fresh-directory verification

data.body: Plan-review triage (art_01M4WEMR2QYGFJGWXE9M1KYK3E, PASS-WITH-NITS): 9 findings, all obvious, all applied in the plan's Cycle 1 Resolutions block (mkdir -p dist; non-errexit reap of the background make up; whitespace-compacted body compares; 400 s bring-up deadline; dirty-tree check excludes .lattice; rebase->merge wording; lsof || true; Ctrl-C comment; TMPDIR trailing slash). No evolutionary findings. One complex question to the human: ship CLAUDE.md/agents.md in the zip or exclude them via a SPEC §12 edit. Implementation proceeds on the default (ship) because the answer changes only one pathspec list in scripts/dist.sh plus the §12 sentence, and no final evidence is recorded before BC-14 lands; the answer is folded in before review.

data.reason: Need: ship CLAUDE.md and agents.md in the recruiter zip, or exclude them (SPEC §12 edit)? Default ship; reviewer recommends exclude: they are Lattice/c11 agent instructions, agents.md duplicates CLAUDE.md, and they reference a .lattice/ the zip omits. Shipping discloses the AI-assisted workflow.

data.note: Operator ruling 05:40Z: ship CLAUDE.md and agents.md in the zip; no SPEC §12 change.

data.body: Operator ruling (human:Forrest, 05:40Z, relayed by orchestrator): ship both CLAUDE.md and agents.md in the recruiter zip as honest disclosure of the AI workflow. No SPEC §12 change.

Implementation at 1c80ba6 (9525970 feat + merge of master after BC-15 landed). Dry run on this tree: make dist -> brillio-listings-20261014.zip 326,997 bytes, 135 files; scripts/verify-dist.sh PASS (13 checks) in ~77 s, run with the three DOCKER/COMPOSE vars still exported; negative checks N1-N6 behave as planned. The fresh-directory run surfaced nothing to fix. make check green (golangci-lint 0 issues, go test -race 5 pkgs, vitest 396/396), shellcheck clean. Deviation from the ticket (recorded per plan): no in-container make check fallback; verify-dist exits 2 naming the missing tool when Go/Node/npm/golangci-lint are absent, because the Compose images have no make or golangci-lint and alpine has no C toolchain for -race. Other deviations: README check also greps 'Then open http://localhost:5173' and the four-listings claim; emoji self-test also requires '1' not to match. Holding before review until BC-14 and BC-16 land (press-ahead note 0).

Review cycle 1 (art_01M4WGH4SYSN488PZN5YADKS1M) FAIL implementation-level; routing: Major orphaned compose client on interrupt -> fix (descendant-tree signal before make down + post-teardown container check); Minor lsof user-scoped -> fix (curl exit-7 probe as in smoke.sh, drop lsof); Nit excluded count -> fix; Nit temp-zip trap -> fix; Nit exit list 141 -> fix. Skipped with reason: native-tool refusal ordering (plan-conformant deviation accepted at plan review, maintainer tool for this host); dingbat marks pass the emoji scan (not Emoji in Unicode, BRANDING §8 bans emoji, none shipped); per-descendant directory-name report (cosmetic). Findings appended to the plan as Review Cycle 1 Findings.

Review cycle 2 (art_01M4WJJ802GNNSTN174BB1MX2R @e5f8317) PASS-WITH-NITS; all cycle-1 items fixed, interrupt re-test clean at +133 s. Routing: Minor Linux root-owned bind-mount paths -> new task BC-23 (inherited BC-13 Compose design, not reproducible on the macOS host). Backlog PID reuse in reap_up + signal latency -> new task BC-24 (out of scope per Orchestrator decision 06:12Z). Nit leftovers comment -> fix (named volumes). Nit Springfield substring match -> fix (exact match). Nit dist.sh total vs breakdown -> skip: reviewer says none required, today 368 = 366+1+1 and the comment explains the glob exclusions match no tracked file. Nits are fixed in-review (minor-fix path, no rework transition), then a short fable re-review names the new HEAD.

Orchestrator decision 06:50Z (MV on BC-23): add a short Linux note to README.md's run section (doc-only, no compose/Makefile change): on a Linux Docker host the stack leaves root-owned frontend/node_modules and data/listings.db, so run make check before make up, or chown after make down. Treated as a trivial nit fix with a doc-delta fable review naming the new HEAD; BC-23 stays in backlog for the compose user mapping.

Review cycle 4 (doc delta @70fa0e0) PASS-WITH-NITS. Routing: Minor verify-dist make check after make up on Linux -> folded into BC-23 (comment there; same root cause, macOS host unaffected). Nit sudo not needed -> skip: the chown form is the Orchestrator's decided wording and is correct. Nits parenthetical ambiguity and figurative phrases ('stays yours', 'hands both back') -> fix: the README is the recruiter-facing deliverable, one-line wording change, then a one-line fable review naming the new HEAD.

Completion (delegator). Built: scripts/dist.sh + Makefile dist target (git archive of HEAD with one pathspec exclusion list: .lattice, both PDFs, dist, node_modules, *.db, OS cruft; one top-level folder brillio-listings-YYYYMMDD/; warns on a dirty tree outside .lattice; prints size, counts, per-category exclusions) and scripts/verify-dist.sh <zip> (unsets DOCKER_DEFAULT_PLATFORM/DOCKER_BUILDKIT/COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD; refuses with exit 2 when 8080/5173 answer, a brillio stack exists or a tool is missing; inspects the zip, extracts into a fresh mktemp dir, emoji scan of every shipped file and path name, checks the README documents each command, then runs only README commands: make up, healthz/cities/Springfield curls, make down, make smoke, make check; trap teardown reaps the make-up process tree before make down). Minimal edits: README layout block + Linux root-owned-files note (Orchestrator decision 06:50Z), SPEC §3 two script lines and §12 verifier sentence (SPEC edit per its deviation rule). Final evidence art_01M4WKRY3F3JNBQ7VSFJNAFCDH at aa2d63a: brillio-listings-20261014.zip 329,238 bytes, 135 files, verify-dist PASS (13 checks) exit 0 in 66 s with the operator vars exported; N1-N3 negative checks pass; nothing left behind. Fresh-directory fixes surfaced: none (the zip ran as-is). Deviations: no in-container make check fallback (exit 2 names the missing tool); operator ruling 05:40Z ships CLAUDE.md and agents.md. Reviews: cycle 1 FAIL (orphaned compose client on interrupt) fixed at e5f8317; cycles 2-4 PASS-WITH-NITS, nits fixed or skipped with reasons; cycle 5 PASS at aa2d63a (art_01M4WKHBHY0RNZJE2VP57NWF1C). Follow-ups created: BC-23 (Linux Docker host root-owned bind-mount paths; real fix is compose user mapping), BC-24 (verify-dist signal-edge hardening).
